title: Level-of-Detail Pyramids of A5 Cells for Browser Rendering
text: s2_santiago, a5view, holds 15,626 resolution-18 cells (22 m across) cloud-free Sentinel-2 mosaic Santiago, Chile, blue, green, red near-infrared bands. writes pyramid representative leaf bands, coarse cell keeps colour real pixel rather blend, mean NDVI. Every coarser level groups leaves cell containing centres, level partitions data ncell counts leaves cell. browser opening file reads footer , kilobytes, tiles draws. a5_read_pyramid() reads levels way:
code: library(a5pyramid)  santiago <- a5view::s2_santiago santiago$ndvi <- with(santiago, (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04))  path <- tempfile(fileext = ".parquet") a5_write_pyramid(   santiago, path,   aggregate = "rep_child",   reducers = c(ndvi = "mean"),   types = c(B02 = "uint16", B03 = "uint16", B04 = "uint16", B08 = "uint16", ndvi = "float32") ) a5_pyramid_info(path) #> ── a5pyramid file 'file2fd74b22e0918a.parquet' ───────────────────────────────── #> Size: 380.3 KB (footer 10.8 KB) #> A5 index: 1.0 #> Leaves: resolution 18, 15,626 cells #> LODs: 2-18 (17 levels) #> Rows: 21,077 #> Row groups: 22 (tile size 4096) #> Columns: B02 <uint16, rep_child>, B03 <uint16, rep_child>, B04 <uint16, #> rep_child>, B08 <uint16, rep_child>, ndvi <float32, mean> #> Bbox: -70.6722, -33.4801, -70.6418, -33.4549 #> Written by: a5pyramid 0.0.0.9000, a5 crate 1.0.0 library(ggplot2)  levels <- a5_read_pyramid(path, lod = c(14, 16, 18)) ggplot(levels, aes(cell = cell, fill = a5view::cells_rgb(B04, B03, B02, range = c(300, 2800)))) +   a5view::geom_a5() +   facet_wrap(~ paste("LOD", lod)) +   theme_void()

title: a5pyramid (development version)
text: First version: Rust engine, R bindings, builds level--detail pyramids A5 cells writes one Parquet file browser rendering. replaces R implementation a5view 0.3. a5_pyramid() builds levels returns tibble; a5_write_pyramid() builds writes Parquet Rust. coarser level groups leaves supercell (a5R::a5_cell_to_supercell()), leaves directly, reduces column "mean", "sum", "min", "max", "mode" "rep_child", optionally weighted. "rep_child" scales column standard deviation, units decide representative, breaks ties lowest cell id; a5view used unscaled distances let rounding break ties. Columns take storage type ("uint8" "float64") shared every level. a5_pyramid_info() reads file’s index footer, a5_read_pyramid() reads levels within bounding box, renderer . a5pyramid_threads() sets session’s thread count, default every available CPU. Results depend , builds can interrupted. tiles runs consecutive cell ids split along A5 hierarchy tile_size rows, sparse data longer makes many tiny row groups, tile one row group; row group boxes come cell boundaries rather padded centroids, cross antimeridian (west > east) instead widening whole globe; index one JSON object key "a5pyramid", levels, value columns, row group boxes flat arrays; columns cell (uint64), lod, ncell value columns names; cell delta encoded, takes 8 bytes per row 3. 439,276 cells, writing pyramid takes 0.48 s 20 threads 4.06 s a5view 0.3, file 28% smaller. engine a5pyramid Rust crate src/rust/a5pyramid, R dependency, published format settles. R bindings separate crate workspace.
